people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.
translations.bsb: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he burned with great anger.
translations.kjv: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
translations.asv: And the Spirit of God came mightily upon Saul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.
